geoworld.create.title: GeoWorld Generation
geoworld.parameter.mainland_scale.desc: Higher gives continents, climate zones, mountain systems, and watersheds more room; lower is more compact. Too low can compress the full geographic hierarchy.
geoworld.parameter.region_scale.desc: Higher makes primary regions larger and more continuous; lower changes them more often. Very high values increase travel distance between regions.
geoworld.parameter.transition_width.desc: Higher makes macro terrain transitions broader and gentler; lower makes boundaries tighter. Wide transitions need more spatial budget.
geoworld.parameter.mountain_strength.des: Higher increases the overall height and relief of major mountain systems; lower softens them. It does not simply sharpen every peak.
geoworld.parameter.plain_continuity.desc: Higher favors large continuous gentle plains; lower allows more local hill breakup. Very high values reduce local terrain variety.
geoworld.parameter.plateau_scale.desc: Higher increases plateau scale and average area; lower makes plateaus smaller and less dominant.
geoworld.parameter.cliff_rarity.desc: Higher makes prominent cliffs rarer; lower increases cliff opportunities. Major mountain systems still follow the shared model.
geoworld.parameter.rare_macro_terrain.de: Higher increases rare rifts, giant valleys, large lake districts, and isolated peaks; lower is more restrained. Extreme values need more world space.
geoworld.parameter.river_density.desc: Higher creates a richer drainage network; lower reduces tributaries. Excessive density can fragment land.
geoworld.parameter.main_river_scale.desc: Higher increases main-river width and valley scale; lower keeps main rivers more compact.
geoworld.parameter.lake_abundance.desc: Higher increases the overall occurrence of lakes at multiple scales; lower reduces lakes.
geoworld.parameter.wetland_abundance.des: Higher increases wetlands in suitable lowlands, estuaries, and lakeshores; lower is drier. It does not force a fixed swamp biome.
Higher enlarges broad forest, grassland, arid, and cold climate regions; lower changes climate more quickly. Very high values increase regional travel distance.
geoworld.parameter.climate_transition_wi: Higher broadens temperature, moisture, and biome transitions; lower tightens them. Wide transitions require more world space.
Higher strengthens windward/leeward precipitation differences; lower weakens mountain rain shadows.
geoworld.parameter.biome_continuity.desc: Higher reduces biome patchwork and enlarges continuous regions; lower allows more local variation.
geoworld.parameter.cave_richness.desc: Higher increases overall cave density; lower preserves more intact rock. Standard still targets fewer background caves than Vanilla.
geoworld.parameter.large_cave_rarity.des: Higher makes truly large caves rarer; lower increases the chance of large cave landmarks.
geoworld.parameter.mineral_regionalizati: Higher strengthens ore-province differences and regional large deposits; lower is more even. Ordinary survival resources are not removed.
geoworld.parameter.spawn_preference.desc: Higher favors normal habitable-mainland spawn candidates; lower is closer to unbiased. It never searches for resource-optimal god seeds.
geoworld.parameter.structure_influence.d: Higher lets local terrain accommodate Vanilla structures more; lower prioritizes natural terrain. Major rivers, mountain systems, giant lakes, and straits stay protected.
geoworld.parameter.outer_island_abundanc: Higher increases offshore and far-ocean islands; lower makes them sparser. The outer ocean never rebuilds a second continent.
geoworld.parameter.polar_transition_widt: Higher lengthens the gradual high-latitude transition into frozen ocean; lower reaches frozen ocean sooner.
geoworld.parameter.ocean_climate_strengt: Higher strengthens the ocean's long-term coastal temperature and moisture influence; lower weakens land-sea contrast. This is not realtime ocean simulation.
geoworld.parameter.prevailing_wind_stren: Higher strengthens long-term prevailing wind, moisture transport, and rain-shadow effects; lower weakens them. It does not create realtime wind.

geoworld.warning.cave_pressure: High cave richness with low large-cave rarity can noticeably reduce intact rock mass.
